verifications.claim: As of early April 2026, Elon Musk is the world's wealthiest person.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Tesla CEO is currently the richest person on the planet'; R2: 'Musk has been the wealthiest person in the world since 2025; as of April 2026'; R3: 'Musk became the first person ever to top the $800 billion mark'; R4: 'Elon Musk is the wealthiest person in the world'; R5: 'Musk sits well above wealthy tech billionaires topping rich lists'; R6: 'Musk ranks first'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Musk is the richest person as of early 2026 dates.

verifications.claim: As of early April 2026, Elon Musk's net worth is estimated around $823 billion to $852 billion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Forbes estimates Musk’s net worth at roughly $823 billion' (April 1, 2026); 'Forbes estimates Musk’s net worth is $837 billion' (March 16); R3: 'with his net worth now around $845 billion, according to Forbes'
verifications.reasoning: Sources from early April cite figures directly within or near the claimed range.

verifications.claim: Elon Musk is the first person to cross the $800 billion mark.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'becoming the first person to do so, ever'; R3: 'Musk became the first person ever to top the $800 billion mark'; R4: 'first person in the world to achieve a net worth of ... $800 billion in February 2026'; R6: 'The Tesla CEO became the first person worth $500 billion, $600 billion, $700 billion and now $800 billion'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm Musk as the first to reach $800B.

verifications.claim: Elon Musk frequently tops the Forbes Real-Time Billionaires List.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'ranks No.1 on the list'; R4: 'Forbes Billionaires List'; R6: 'Forbes 2026 Billionaires list'; R7: 'Forbes Real-Time Billionaires List'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm he tops Forbes lists, including real-time, but 'frequently' is broader and not quantified precisely.

verifications.claim: Elon Musk's fortune surpassed $800 billion in early 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'now $800 billion net worth milestones' (early 2026 context); R3: 'this week' (Feb 2026 article); R4: '$800 billion in February 2026'; R6: '$800 billion... since October 2025' but early 2026 confirmed
verifications.reasoning: Sources place the $800B milestone in early 2026.

verifications.claim: Elon Musk has a 42% stake in SpaceX.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Musk currently owns about 42% of SpaceX, according to PitchBook'; multiple mentions of 42-45%; R3: 'Musk’s ownership estimated at around 43%'
verifications.reasoning: 42% directly stated; minor variations (43-45%) in same context support precisely.

verifications.claim: Elon Musk's 42% stake in SpaceX is valued at roughly $336 billion.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SpaceX recently valued at $1.25 trillion, his ownership... worth over $500 billion'; '43%... $538 billion'; past 'from $800 billion' but current valuations higher ($1.25T+)
verifications.reasoning: Refs value 42-43% stake at $500B+ based on current $1.25T valuation; $336B mismatches current value (42% of $800B past valuation).

verifications.claim: Elon Musk has a 12% stake in Tesla.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'representing about 12% of the company'; 'Musk owns about 15%'; R2: implies similar via wealth breakdown
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated as 12% in R1; minor variance to 15% consistent.
